s-1.ptxt: Install Fuel Injector Assembly

s2.ptxt: Install a new insulator to the injector.
Apply gasoline to a new O-ring and install it to the injector.
Apply gasoline to the injector installation hole of the fuel delivery pipe.
While turning the fuel injector left and right, install it to the fuel delivery pipe.

atten3.ptxt: Install the O-ring so that it is not twisted.
After installing it to the delivery pipe, check that the injector rotates smoothly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Fuel Delivery Pipe w/ Injector

s2.ptxt: Set the 2 spacers on the cylinder head.
Install the fuel delivery pipe w/ injector to the cylinder head.

atten3.ptxt: Do not drop the fuel injectors when installing the fuel delivery pipe.

s2.ptxt: Temporarily tighten the 2 bolts.
Turn the fuel injectors left and right by hand to check that they are installed without excessive force.

atten4.ptxt: If a fuel injector does not rotate smoothly, replace the O-ring with a new one and reinstall it.

s2.ptxt: Position the fuel injector connectors toward the rear of the vehicle.
Tighten the 2 bolts.
Install the 3 wire harness clamps. (*2)
Connect the 4 fuel injector connectors.
Connect the oil control valve connector (*1).
Connect the throttle body connector.

s2.ptxt: Connect the oxygen sensor connector and clamp.

s2.ptxt: Connect the ventilation hose No.2 with the clamp.

s-1.ptxt: Connect Fuel Tube Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Align the axes of the fuel pressure pulsation damper pipe and the fuel tube connector, and push the fuel tube in securely until it clicks (for the procedure, refer to ).
Install EFI fuel pipe clamp No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Install Air Cleaner Cap w/ Air Cleaner Hose

s2.ptxt: Install the hinge portion first, then install the air cleaner cap with the 3 clamps.
Install air cleaner hose No.1 to the throttle body assembly and release the lock of air cleaner hose clamp No.1.

item.ptxt: Align the triangular projection of air cleaner hose No.1 with the throttle body bolt on the right front side of the vehicle.
Align the position of air cleaner hose clamp No.1 using the triangular projection of air cleaner hose No.1 as a reference.

s2.ptxt: Connect the clamp and intake air flow meter connector.
Connect the fuel vapor feed hose and fuel vapor feed hose No.2 to vacuum switching valve assembly No.1.
Connect the clamp and vacuum switching valve connector.
Connect the ventilation hose.
